name: Echo N7 ANC
description: Flat-folding over-ear headphones with adaptive noise cancellation and a talk-through button for hearing your surroundings. Dual memory-foam cushions and a padded headband for long listening sessions.

reviews.title: Great sound and noise cancellation
reviews.text: I use them at night for podcasts. The sound is great and the noise cancellation is superb.

reviews.title: Surprisingly impressed
reviews.text: I'm a bit of a headphone snob and had high expectations at this price. They passed every test I ran.

reviews.title: Battery stopped holding charge
reviews.text: Worked well for a long time, then suddenly would not hold more than 10% charge.

name: Orbit Air 60
description: Lightweight foldable Bluetooth headphones with up to 60 hours of playtime and six EQ presets. Built-in microphone for calls. No active noise cancelling.

reviews.title: Excellent quality for the price
reviews.text: Very good for the money. If you want premium sound, pay the premium price.

reviews.title: Feels loose
reviews.text: Not very sturdy and feels loose on my head. Would not stay on while exercising.

reviews.title: Fine for TV
reviews.text: Good battery life and they sound decent. There is no noise cancellation, which I did not need anyway.

name: Kestrel XB880
description: Over-ear Bluetooth headphones with 40 mm drivers, soft protein-leather cushions and on-cup controls. Works wirelessly or with the included cable. Passive isolation only.

specifications.Connectivity: Bluetooth and 3.5 mm cable
specifications.Controls: Volume and track buttons, built-in microphone

reviews.title: Great sound for the price
reviews.text: Really like the look and the bass. Only drawback is that no case is included.

reviews.title: Daughter loves them
reviews.text: Comfortable, and she can skip songs with the side button.

reviews.title: No battery indicator
reviews.text: Sound is good, but they just go dead with no warning that the battery is low.

name: Kestrel Flat S2
description: Lightweight flat-folding on-ear Bluetooth headphones with a 17-hour battery and a three-button remote for volume, playback and calls.

reviews.title: Perfect for walks

name: Wave Q35 ANC
description: Over-ear wireless headphones with multi-mode active noise cancelling. Custom silk-diaphragm drivers cover a wide frequency range with low distortion, and a hi-res Bluetooth codec carries more detail than standard Bluetooth. Memory-foam earcups for all-day wear and four beamforming microphones for clear calls.

specifications.Noise control: Active noise cancelling with Transport, Outdoor and Indoor modes
specifications.Connectivity: Bluetooth 5.0 with hi-res codec; 3.5 mm cable included
specifications.Battery: Up to 40 hours with noise cancelling on

reviews.title: Excellent sound, a bit tight after a few hours
reviews.text: The app made them easy to set up and the hi-res mode sounds very good. After about three hours the clamp feels tight on me, so I take short breaks.

reviews.title: Huge bass upgrade
reviews.text: A big step up from my old gaming headset. You don't realise how much bass you were missing until you try these.

reviews.title: Great noise cancelling
reviews.text: Love the noise cancelling and the sound. The Transport mode makes the MRT ride much quieter. Would recommend.

reviews.title: Bluetooth dropped after two months
reviews.text: Started having Bluetooth connection issues after two months. Still works fine with the cable.

reviews.title: Very comfortable
reviews.text: More comfortable than my previous premium pair, and a lot cheaper. I keep them as my daily commuting headphones.
